## Core Specializations

### 1. Ethical Hacking & Cybersecurity in Pakistan
- **Penetration Testing & Web Auditing**: Comprehensive web application vulnerability assessments based on OWASP Top 10 guidelines (SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, IDOR, SSRF).
- **Security Hardening**: Implementation of Content Security Policy (CSP), HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS), and secure authentication architectures.
- **Tools & Environments**: Kali Linux, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark, Bash & Python scripting.
- **Cybersecurity Education**: Over 20,000 community members on TikTok and YouTube learning ethical hacking, bug hunting, and cyber defense best practices.

### 2. Full Stack Next.js & Web Development in Pakistan
- **Next.js 16 & React 19**: Modern App Router architecture, React Server Components (RSC), dynamic SSR, and static site generation (SSG).
- **Full Stack Engineering**: High-performance RESTful APIs, Node.js backend integration, and end-to-end TypeScript type safety.
- **Custom Business & E-Commerce Web Platforms**: Bespoke corporate websites, client portals, SaaS dashboards, and high-conversion e-commerce storefronts.
